## Invitations

A total of 6855 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was recorded at 4881, giving an overall attendance rate of 71.2 per cent. These figures provide a summary of the invitation and attendance activity and support review of engagement with the outreach service. The attendance result is presented alongside the invitation total to provide a clear account of participation.

## Contact

SMS contact was made with 5826 invitees. The recorded number of reminders was 0. SMS activity and reminder activity are reported separately so that the contact record remains clear and transparent. The figures show the volume of direct contact undertaken and the number of reminders recorded for the period. This information should be considered with the invitation and attendance figures when reviewing outreach activity.

Prepared by G. Evans.
